blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Financial reports repeat values across periods, metrics and accounting lines, allowing an LLM-generated calculation to be numerically correct while citing the wrong financial role. We evaluate what probabilistic evidence verification adds beyond number matching using Jev as a source-support verifier for GPT-4.1-mini calculation traces. A signed-number-at-pointer baseline explains most recovery over exact quotation checks. To isolate the remaining role-recognition problem, we hold operands and arithmetic fixed, move citations between same-number cells, and retain controls that express equivalent facts. These contrasts reveal both wrong-role citations that pass and valid alternative citations that are withheld. Explicit column labels improve selected wrong-role decisions while also lowering support for some equivalent evidence. A constructed follow-up on 36 new source pages, labeled by a non-author reviewer, extends this evaluation and exposes the same tradeoff between detecting role errors and retaining valid citations. The contribution is a controlled evaluation that identifies what a probabilistic financial verifier distinguishes when numerical matching is held fixed. For LLM-based financial assistants, it makes numerical correctness, cited-role support and acceptance outcomes separately assessable.
blocks.zh: 财务报告在跨期间、计量和会计科目中重复价值,使LLM生成的计算数字正确,同时引用错误的财务作用。 我们用Jev作为GPT-4.1-mini计算痕迹的源支持验证器,来评估概率证据核查在数字比对之外增加什么。 签出数字的基线可以解释大多数回收情况,而不是确切的报价核对。 为了分离剩下的角色识别问题,我们固定操作和算术,在同数单元格之间移动引用,并保留表达等同事实的控制. 这些对比表明,有错误的作用引用是经过的,有有效的替代引用是拒绝的。 明确的列标签改进了选定的错误作用决定,同时也降低了对一些等同证据的支持. 对36个新来源页的构建后的后续行动由非作者审查者标出标签,扩展了这一评价,并暴露出在发现角色错误和保留有效引用之间相同的取舍. 这种贡献是一种控制性评价,它确定一个概率财务核查员在数字匹配被固定时有何区别。 对于基于LLM的财务助理来说,它使数字正确性、引用作用支持和接受结果可以单独评估。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: An LLM-based financial research assistant produces a numerical calculation and citations for its operands. Verifying the output requires checking both the calculation and the cited cells’ period, metric and accounting role. In our GPT-4.1-mini records, 27 of 192 traces have executed outputs that match the answer key yet cite unsupported roles. A literal quotation check already catches all 27, making it essential to compare probabilistic verification against deterministic citation checks. We ask what the verifier adds once numerical citation matching is in place, and whether it retains valid evidence while detecting role errors.
blocks.zh: 一个基于LLM的金融研究助理为其操作制作数字计算和引用. 核查产出需要检查计算和引用的单元格的周期、计量和会计作用。 在我们的GPT-4.1-mini记录中,192个痕迹中,有27个完成了与答案密钥相匹配的产出,但却引用了不支持的角色. 一个字面的引号检查已经把全部27个都抓了起来,因此必须比较概率核查和确定性引号检查。 我们询问,当数字引用匹配实现后,核查者会添加什么,以及它是否保留有效证据,同时检测角色错误。

blocks.en: FinQA supplies numerical reasoning questions over financial reports [ 1 ] . Its answers come with gold programs, but a number and its cited basis still have to be assessed separately. FinanceBench pairs financial answers with supporting evidence [ 2 ] . Financial reports repeat the same value across years, metrics and accounting categories, so a value found at a citation may belong to the wrong role, while a different citation may express the same fact. We ask: what does probabilistic financial evidence verification add beyond numerical matching, and which citation changes reveal its limits?
blocks.zh: FinQA提供财务报告的数字推理问题[1]. 它的答案有黄金方案,但数字及其引用的依据仍需单独评估。 Finance Bench将财务答案与支持证据相配 [2]. 财务报告逐年重复同样的价值,计量和会计类别,因此在引用时发现的一个价值可能属于错误的角色,而不同的引用可能表达相同的事实. 我们问:概率财务证据核查除了数字比对之外又增加了哪些内容,哪些引用变化揭示其局限性?

blocks.en: We use Jev to verify GPT-4.1-mini calculation traces, each containing operands, an operation, source pointers and an answer. We resolve each pointer into the supplied excerpt and ask Jev whether the cited evidence supports the calculation. This source-support probability concerns a different event from numerical answer selection.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Jev来验证GPT-4.1-mini计算痕迹,每个都包含操作,操作,源指和答案. 我们解决所提供的节选中的每个指针,并询问Jev引用的证据是否支持计算. 此源支持概率涉及不同于数字答案选择的事件 。

blocks.en: The experiments build on one another. Natural traces give performance against retained source labels, and a signed-number-at-pointer rule measures the contribution of number matching. Same-number swaps then hold numerical agreement fixed to test financial-role recognition, with equivalent-fact controls distinguishing harmless citation changes from genuine role errors. Explicit column rendering probes selected failures while preserving the source. A follow-up repeats the design on new pages selected using source information alone, with non-author source review.
blocks.zh: 实验是互相加强的 自然的痕迹给出了相对于所保留的源标签的性能,一个被签名的点数规则衡量数字匹配的贡献. 同位数互换随后持有固定数字协议来测试金融-作用识别,等效事实控制区分无害引用变化和真实角色错误. 清晰的列渲染探测器在保存源时会选择失败. 后续在仅使用源信息选择的新页面上重复设计,非作者源审查.

blocks.en: The evaluation measures incremental value as supported acceptances and joint passes relative to signed-number matching, financial-role discrimination at fixed numerical agreement, and representation sensitivity under explicit column rendering. Equivalent-fact controls measure retention of valid evidence. The 192 natural records are LLM outputs; the 36-question follow-up uses program-derived records. Historical assistant labels and returned reviewer labels remain distinct throughout. Together, these comparisons characterize a probabilistic verification component for financial assistants.
blocks.zh: 评价衡量的是所支持的接受额和联合转让额相对于签名数字比对、固定数字协议中的财务作用差别和明细列显示中的代表敏感性的递增值。 等效-事实控制衡量有效证据的保留。 192个自然记录是LLM输出;36个问题后续使用由程序产生的记录. 历史助理的标签和回回审查员的标签在整个过程中始终是不同的. 这些比较共同构成财务助理的概率核查部分。

blocks.en: Section IV reports the original, prospectively specified release endpoint. Component corrections did not improve fixed-gate released answers on this bank; the later source-support evaluation addresses the evidence-verification component.
blocks.zh: 第四节报告最初的、预期指定的释放终点。 部分更正没有改进该银行公布的固定门答案;后来的源支持评价涉及证据核实部分。

blocks.en: II Financial records and measurement targets
blocks.zh: 二. 财务记录和计量目标

blocks.en: II-A Source population and calculation traces
blocks.zh: II-A 来源人口和计算痕迹

blocks.en: The bank contains 96 FinQA test questions with single-operation calculations. The source is fixed to FinQA revision 0f16e286 [ 1 ] . Of 1,147 test records, 243 pass the structural screen, spanning 175 source pages. Source-only assistant review of the first 144 hash-ranked pages accepts 115. We additionally exclude a known cross-year duplicate of a reserved repair-pilot question, then take the first 96 remaining accepted questions. They cover 96 pages and 88 company/year reports. Retained screening decisions and reasons define the study population: selected single-operation questions from the benchmark.
blocks.zh: 银行包含96个FinQA测试问题,采用单操作计算. 该出处被固定为FinQA修订版0f16e286 [1]. 在1 147个测试记录中,243个通过结构屏幕,跨越175个源页。 对前144个排行榜页面的仅源助理审查接受115. 此外,我们排除了已知的年复一年的重复保留修理驾驶问题,然后处理其余96个被接受的问题。 它们包括96页和88份公司/年度报告。 保留筛选决定和理由定义了研究人口:从基准中选择的单操作问题.

blocks.en: Before collection, we committed the sample, prompts, execution rules, original release policies and analysis specification. Each question receives one Jev numerical selection and two GPT-4.1-mini traces from identical menu-free inputs. Jev selects among five numerical candidates: the rounded key, one numerical neighbor and three arithmetic distractors, assigned to neutral IDs. A fixed rule consults a trace only when the maximum Choice probability is strictly below 0.8; this selector role defines the bank’s original release endpoint (Section IV ), while the later verifier role studied in Section III evaluates cited evidence. All 288 requests succeed on their first attempt. Both draws are retained, yielding the 192 natural records. Later source-probability and citation experiments were designed after inspecting these records: retrospective extensions of a prospectively collected bank.
blocks.zh: 在收集之前,我们承诺了样本,提示,执行规则,原始发布政策和分析规格. 每个问题都收到一个Jev数字选择和两个GPT-4.1-mini从相同的菜单无输入得到的痕迹. Jev从五个数字候选人中选择:四舍五入的密钥,一个数字邻居和三个算术分辨器,分配到中性ID. 固定规则只有在最大选择概率严格低于0.8时才会查询追踪;这种选择者角色定义了银行最初的放行终点(第四节),而第三节所研究的后期核查者角色评价所引用的证据. 所有288项请求都首次成功。 这两张图都保留下来,产生了192个自然记录。 后来的源概率和引用实验是在检查这些记录之后设计的:一个预期收集的银行的追溯延伸.

blocks.en: External calculation is established in PAL [ 3 ] . Checking an operand’s financial role requires linking that operand to its source context. Financial QA agents also use external calculation [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 外部计算是在PAL [3]. 检查一个操作器的财务作用需要将该操作器与它的源背景联系起来。 金融质量保证代理商也采用外部计算[4].

blocks.en: Each trace requests two decimal operands, their source pointers and quotations, one arithmetic operation, a stated answer, an output unit and a justification. A bounded executor applies predefined addition, subtraction, multiplication or division to the supplied operands at their emitted scale, then rounds to the frozen question precision. Missing-operand inference, value rescaling and generated-code execution are outside its scope. Stated and executed numbers are paired readings of the same trace. The model receives the question and supplied financial excerpt; the numerical key, gold reasoning program and source annotations are withheld.
blocks.zh: 每个跟踪请求两个十进制操作,它们的源指和引出,一个算术操作,一个被声明的答案,一个输出单元和一个理由. 受限执行器对所供应的操作量按所放出的规模对所提供操作量采用预先定义的加法、减法、乘法或除法,然后将各轮对所放出的问题精度进行分解。 缺少-operand推论,数值缩放和生成代码执行都超出了其范围. 已声明和已执行的数字是相同追踪的对读数。 该模型接收了问题,并提供了财务摘录;数字密钥,黄金推理程序和源说明被扣.

blocks.en: II-B Numerical correctness, evidence support and acceptance
blocks.zh: 二-B 数字正确性、证据支持和接受

blocks.en: Numerical correctness means matching the frozen rounded FinQA-derived key. Mismatches and unavailable outputs are separate outcomes. We assess numerical correctness and source support as separate dimensions: source support concerns the cited operands’ financial roles, while numerical correctness also depends on arithmetic and output scaling.
blocks.zh: 数值正确性是指与被冻结的四舍五入的FinQA派生密钥相匹配. 偏差和无法提供的产出是单独的结果。 我们评估数字正确性和源支持作为单独的维度:源支持涉及所引用的操作符的财务作用,而数字正确性也取决于算术和产出的缩放.

blocks.en: Cited-role support asks whether the actual cited cells, rows, headers or text spans provide the operands in the roles required by the question: metric, entity or cohort, period, status and contextual sign. It also includes task-role completeness; for example, a cash-spent calculation requires evidence beyond share counts. Arithmetic order and final unit conversion are assessed separately from the cited roles. Assistant review assigns supported, unsupported, ambiguous or unassessable labels and retains a source-linked reason. An additional full-excerpt judgment asks whether the expressed calculation is recoverable elsewhere in the supplied evidence. Cited-role support remains anchored to the actual emitted pointer.
blocks.zh: 被引用的作用支持询问实际被引用的单元格、行、标题或文本跨度是否提供问题所要求的作用的操作:度量、实体或组、周期、状态和背景标志。 它还包括任务作用的完整性;例如,现金支出的计算需要超出份额计算的证据。 算术顺序和最终单元转换与所引用的角色分开评估. 助理审查指定了支持的、不支持的、模棱两可的或无法评估的标签,并保留了与源相关的理由。 另一项全面摘录判决询问,在提供的证据中,明示的计算是否可以在其他地方收回。 所引用的作用支持仍然固定在实际发射的指针上。

blocks.en: The natural-record source labels come from unblinded assistant review of all 192 traces, with documented adjudications and two unresolved records retained. Support is defined by the cited source context; numerical outcomes and later verifier probabilities are separate readouts. Independent human confirmation of these natural-record labels remains incomplete. The returned non-author review in Section III-D applies exclusively to the new constructed contrasts.
blocks.zh: 自然记录源标签来自对所有192个痕迹的无盲助手审查,并保留了有文件记载的裁决和2个未解决的记录. 支持由所引用的源上下文定义;数字结果和后作词的概率是单独的读出. 人类对这些自然记录标签的独立确认仍未完成。 第三至D节中退回的非作者审查仅适用于所构建的新对比。

blocks.en: Literal correspondence requires the emitted quotation and numerical operand span to agree with the location addressed by the pointer. Combined with available execution and matching output units, this forms the literal/unit acceptance rule. Acceptance is a decision under a stated rule, distinct from source support and from numerical correctness. At a high acceptance cutoff, a withheld citation can still carry a support probability above 0.5. A joint pass requires both supported cited roles and an executed key match.
blocks.zh: 字面通信要求所发射的引文和数字操作间距与指针地址一致。 这与可用的执行和匹配的产出单元相结合,构成了字面/单位接受规则. 接受是根据既定规则作出的决定,不同于来源支持和数字正确性。 在接受率高的截断时,被扣取的引文仍然可以携带超过0.5的支持概率. 联合通行证既需要获得支持的被引用的角色,也需要执行的密钥匹配.

blocks.en: Evidence binding refers here to resolving a citation to its actual source location and presenting that location’s context. The initial verifier input includes the complete source table, visible row/column indices, the table’s header row and the cited row. Thus column identity is already recoverable. The later intervention repeats the selected column’s header explicitly alongside the citation, varying its representation while holding source availability fixed.
blocks.zh: 在此,具有约束力的证据是指解决其实际来源地的引用和说明该地的背景。 最初的校验输入包括完整的源表,可见行/列索引,表头行和被引用行. 因此列身份已经可以恢复 。 以后的发言在引文的同时明确重复所选栏目的标题,在固定来源的同时,也改变其表述方式。

blocks.en: II-C Models and reporting units
blocks.zh: 二-C 模式和报告单位

blocks.en: All Jev calls return typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917 through OpenRouter with the TypeSafe provider. Numerical answer selection uses Choice; source verification uses one independently specified binary Noul event. Choice and Noul probabilities are analyzed as distinct measurement targets. Analyses use the exact returned probabilities, preserving their original scale; the interface’s native confidence statistic is excluded from accuracy estimation.
blocks.zh: 所有Jev与TypeSafe供应商通过OpenRouter呼叫回放型安全/jev-1.13-20260917. 数字解答选择使用Choice;源校验使用一个独立指定的二进制努尔事件. 选择和努尔概率被分析为不同的衡量目标。 分析使用准确的返回概率,保留其原始尺度;界面的本土信心统计被排除在准确估计之外。

blocks.en: GPT-4.1-mini uses the OpenAI provider, disabled provider fallback, temperature 0, top-p 1 and a 1,024-token output limit for traces. The prompt requests JSON, and decoding is unconstrained. The returned openai/gpt-4.1-mini identifier is a serving alias; it does not pin immutable model weights. Jev selection and menu-free trace generation have different tasks and output budgets, defining a workflow comparison between their assigned roles.
blocks.zh: GPT-4.1-mini使用OpenAI提供商,被禁用提供商倒置,温度为0,上-p 1,并有1,024-token输出限制的痕迹. 即时请求JSON,并解码不受约束. 返回的Openai/gpt-4.1-mini标识器是一种服务用别名;它不会将不可变的模型重量标出. Jev选择和无菜单的痕量生成有不同的任务和产出预算,定义了他们分配的角色之间的工作流程比较.

blocks.en: Natural-record summaries retain all traces and question identities. Verifier and original-release resampling runs use 2,000 and 20,000 draws, respectively. Question bootstrap intervals quantify variation across sampled questions while retaining both draws. Annotation uncertainty and future serving variation lie outside their coverage. Constructed citation studies report contrasts and source questions separately; repeated identical inputs are counted as technical calls within the same semantic case.
blocks.zh: 自然记录摘要保留了所有痕迹和问题身份。 验证器和原放出再生试样运行分别使用2000和2万图纸. 提问拖带间隔对所抽样问题的差异进行量化,同时保留两种图纸。 说明的不确定性和未来的服务性变化不在它们的涵盖范围之内。 构造引用研究报告对比和源问题分开;重复的相同输入在同一语义中算作技术调用.

blocks.en: III Verification experiments
blocks.zh: 三. 核查试验

blocks.en: III-A Natural records: discrimination and a stronger numerical control
blocks.zh: 自然记录:歧视和加强数字控制

blocks.en: The natural records contain both numerical and citation errors (Table I ). Of 192 executed outputs, 170 match the key, 21 do not, and one is unavailable. Source review finds 153 supported traces, 37 unsupported, one ambiguous and one unassessable. Twenty-seven key-matching traces on 14 questions cite unsupported roles even though their derivations are recoverable elsewhere in the excerpt. Literal correspondence detects all 27, demonstrating why numerical correctness and cited-role support require separate assessment. Conversely, literal correspondence rejects 33 supported traces. The combined literal/unit rule accepts two unsupported-role traces; both are numerical mismatches.
blocks.zh: 自然记录包括数字和引用错误(表一)。 在192项已执行产出中,170项与关键值相符,21项没有,1项没有。 来源审查发现153个支持的痕迹,37个不支持,一个模棱两可,一个无法评估. 14个问题的27个密钥比对痕迹列举了未得到支持的角色,尽管其衍生物可在节选的其他地方找到。 文学函证检测到所有27个,表明数字正确性和引用-作用支持为何需要单独评估. 相反地,字面上的通信拒绝33个支持的痕迹。 合并字/单位规则接受两个不支持-作用的痕迹;两者都是数字不匹配.

blocks.en: TABLE I: Numerical outputs and cited-role diagnostics on the fresh bank.
blocks.zh: 表格 一:新银行的数值产出和引用作用诊断。

blocks.en: We next ask whether a probabilistic source verifier can improve this acceptance tradeoff. Every natural-record, citation-swap and rendering request uses the same fixed Noul instruction, beginning: "Does the cited evidence support the proposed record’s operand values and financial roles for the quantity requested in the question?" The instruction requires support at the actual cited locations for the requested metric or entity, period, sign and source unit, allowing harmless paraphrases and using surrounding context. It explicitly excludes rejection based solely on a wrong arithmetic operator, operand order, final rounding or missing final display-unit conversion. The same instruction is present in all 590 saved evaluation requests, including the fresh-source follow-up in Section III-D .
blocks.zh: 我们接下来问一个概率源验证器是否能够改进这种接受权衡. 每个自然记录,引用-扫描和渲染请求都使用相同的固定的努尔语指令,开始: “所引用的证据是否支持拟议记录的操作价值以及该问题所要求的数量的财务作用?” 该指令要求所请求的度量或实体、周期、标志和源单位在实际引用的地点得到支持,允许使用无害的参数并使用周围上下文。 它明确排除完全基于错误的算术操作员、操作顺序、最后四舍五入或缺失的最后显示单位转换的拒绝。 在所有590项保存的评价请求中,包括第三至D节中的新来源后续说明中,都有同样的指示。

blocks.en: Only the allowlisted source and record state varies. Jev receives the full supplied excerpt, question, requested unit and precision, operation, operands, justification, executed value and deterministically resolved citations. The numerical key, source labels, checker verdicts and original stated-answer field are absent. This input defines the source-support target while leaving numerical-correctness cues available to the model. We wrote the predicate after inspecting the retained labels and tested the input format in four development checks; all 192 natural-record requests then succeeded. The experiment evaluates a new probability target retrospectively on known records.
blocks.zh: 只有允许的列表源和记录状态不同. Jev收到提供的全部节选、询问、要求的单位和精确度、操作、操作、理由、执行值和决定性解决的引用。 数字密钥、源标签、检查器裁定和原复答字段都不存在。 此输入定义了源支持目标,同时给模型留下了数值-正确性提示. 我们在检查了保留标签后写下了上游,并用四个开发检查测试了输入格式;然后所有192个自然记录请求都成功. 实验对已知记录的一个新的概率目标进行了回顾性评价.

blocks.en: On the 190 binary labels, the source probabilities have Brier score 0.03378 and AUROC 0.98587. Question-bootstrap 95% intervals from 2,000 resamples are [0.01814, 0.05260] and [0.96356, 0.99938], respectively. The binary support rate of 0.8053 is close to the mean probability of 0.7975. Calibration also requires agreement within probability ranges: in the largest fixed probability bin, 146 records have mean probability 0.9375 and observed support rate 0.9932. A pre-inference sensitivity excluding six task-role boundary records from questions 467, 576 and 991 retains 184 binary records, with Brier 0.03132 and AUROC 0.98551. Original labels remain unchanged.
blocks.zh: 在190个二进制标签上,源概率有Brier得分0.03378和AUROC 0.98587. 由2000个复标产生的95%的间隔分别为[0.01814,0.05260]和[0.96356,0.9938]. 二进制支持率为0.8053,接近于0.7975的平均概率. 校准还需要在概率范围内达成一致:在最大的固定概率站中,146个记录有平均概率为0.9375并观察到的支持率为0.9932. 从问题467、576和991中排除6个任务作用边界记录的推断前敏感性保留了184个二进制记录,其中Brier 0.03132和AUROC 0.98551。 原始标签保持不变。

blocks.en: At the inclusive 0.8 source-probability cutoff, all 27 key-matching traces with unsupported cited roles are withheld (maximum probability 0.79), as are nine of the ten unsupported traces with numerical mismatches. Thus no correct-number/unsupported-role trace is accepted at that cutoff in this natural bank. Section III-B tests role recognition with numerical agreement held fixed.
blocks.zh: 在包容性0.8源概率截断时,所有27个没有支持的被引用角色的密钥匹配痕迹被扣取(最大概率为0.79),十个没有支持的有数字不匹配的痕迹中的九个也是如此. 因此,在这个天然银行的截断点上,没有接受正确的数字/不支持的作用追踪。 第三-B节测试作用的确认,并定值协议。

blocks.en: To measure the increment beyond number matching, we add a post hoc zero-call control, the relaxed pointer rule: remove exact-quotation matching while still requiring each signed operand value at its actual cited location. Matching is confined to the string at the emitted table-cell or text-span pointer, using the operand’s original sign and scale. Whole-row list pointers are ineligible. Numerical spans are matched as complete decimal values, ignoring thousands separators while preserving accounting parentheses as a negative sign. The shared release guards require an available execution and exact equality of the emitted and requested unit strings. This guard checks unit labels; scaling correctness is a separate numerical question. Both rules operate on the source and emitted record, with answer keys and support labels excluded.
blocks.zh: 为了衡量数字比对之外的增量,我们增加了一个特设的零调取控制,即宽松的指针规则:去掉精确的引号比对,同时仍然需要每个在实际被引用位置上签名的操作值. 匹配仅限于已发射的表格单元格或文本宽指针的字符串, 使用操作符的原始符号和比例 。 全行列表指针不合格 。 数字相匹配为完整的小数值,忽略了千个分隔符,同时保留了会计括号作为负号. 共享释放看守要求执行可用的执行,并且所释放的和要求的单位字符串精确的等同. 这个警卫检查单位标签;缩放正确性是一个单独的数字问题. 这两种规则都运行在源头和被放出的记录上,不包括答案密钥和支持标签.

blocks.en: Table II retains all four inclusive cutoffs listed before verifier inference: 0.5, 0.8, 0.9 and 0.95. New releases require available execution and matching output units in addition to the probability gate. The OR policy rescues records rejected by the original literal/unit rule. Unresolved labels remain in the full denominator rather than becoming supported records.
blocks.zh: 表二保留了核查员推论前列出的所有四个包容性断面:0.5、0.8、0.9和0.95。 新的发行除了概率门外,还需要可用的执行和匹配输出单元. OR政策拯救记录被原字/单位规则所拒绝. 未解的标签仍保留在完整分母中,而不是成为支持的记录.

blocks.en: TABLE II: Source-probability gates on the existing 192 traces. All thresholds are inclusive. Supported/unsupported/unresolved refer to retained assistant source-role labels; joint passes additionally match the numerical key.
blocks.zh: 表格 二:现有192个痕迹的源概率门. 所有门槛都是包容性的。 被支持/不支持/未解指被保留的助手源-作用标签;联合传出额外匹配数字密钥.

blocks.en: This relaxed pointer rule recovers 31 of the 33 supported literal failures and 24 of the 26 that also match the key, with no additional unsupported acceptance and one ambiguous acceptance.
blocks.zh: 这种宽松的指针规则在支持的33个字形失败中恢复了31个,在同样匹配键的26个中恢复了24个,没有额外的不支持的接受和一个模棱两可的接受.

blocks.en: At 0.8, Jev accepts 146 records with 142 joint passes, compared with 154 accepted and 141 joint passes for the relaxed rule. The tradeoff is fewer accepted records for one additional joint pass. The two Jev-only joint passes both belong to question 218, where a negative benefit is used as a positive magnitude in a subtraction. This contextual-sign case identifies the specific distinction from strict signed-number matching. As a hard 0/1 classifier, the relaxed rule also has lower Brier score on these labels (4/190 = 0.02105), although its erroneous certainties have infinite unregularized log loss. These comparisons motivate testing role recognition while holding numerical matches fixed.
blocks.zh: 0.8分,捷夫接受146个记录,共有142个联通通行证,而放宽规则则接受154个联通通行证和141个联通通行证. 取舍则减少另外一张联合通行证的接受记录。 两段Jev-唯一接合的通关卡都属于问题218,其中负益被用为减法中的正分. 此上下文符号大小写确定了与严格的签名数字匹配的具体区别. 作为硬的0/1分级器,宽松的规则在这些标签上也有更低的Brier分数(4/190 = 0.02105),尽管其错误的确定性有无限的无规范的日志损失. 这些比较促使测试角色识别,同时保持数字匹配。

blocks.en: Paired decision differences. At the same inclusive 0.8 cutoff and with identical release guards, both rules accept 144 traces, Jev alone accepts two, the numerical rule alone accepts ten, and both withhold 36. Their joint-pass counts in these groups are 140, two, one and zero, respectively. The net gain of one joint pass is therefore two recoveries on question 218 minus one withheld valid trace on question 583, draw 1. Removing both question-218 traces leaves 190 records: Jev has 140 joint passes versus 141 for the numerical rule. This leave-one-question-out sensitivity locates the observed increment in a single contextual-sign case.
blocks.zh: 裁决有分歧。 在同一包含0.8的截取和相同的放出守卫中,两种规则都接受144个痕迹,Jev单独接受2个,数字规则单独接受10个,两者都保留了36个. 他们在这些组中的联通计分分别为140个,2个,1个和0个. 因此,一次联合出入证的净收益是问题218的两次追回,再减去问题583的一次扣下的有效追踪,图1。 删除两个问题-218的痕迹留下了190个记录: Jev有140个联赛通行证,而数字规则有141个。 这种 " 一个问题 " 的敏感度将发现的增量定位在单一的上下文标记上。

blocks.en: Seven of the ten rule-only acceptances have supported cited roles but mismatched numerical answers, spanning four questions. They explain the difference between ten such accepted traces under the rule and three under Jev. Withholding these records can improve accepted-answer precision while leaving the joint-pass count unchanged. The pattern links lower source probabilities to broader calculation defects. Because arithmetic, explanations and other input features vary together in these natural traces, their individual contributions remain unresolved.
blocks.zh: 十个只按规则接受的回答中,有七个支持被引用的角色,但数字答案不匹配,涉及四个问题. 他们解释了规则下10个这样的接受的痕迹和Jev下3个的痕迹之间的区别。 保留这些记录可以提高接受的答案精确度,同时使联通数保持不变。 模式将更低的源概率与更广泛的计算缺陷联系起来. 由于这些自然痕迹中的算术,解释和其他输入特征各有不同,所以它们各自的贡献仍未得到解决.

blocks.en: III-B Same-number citations: isolating financial role
blocks.zh: 三-B 同号引文:孤立金融作用

blocks.en: Systematic tabular-reasoning probes use evidence perturbations to examine model behavior [ 5 ] . We apply this logic to a source-support verifier while holding operands and arithmetic fixed. TabDSR also uses table-data perturbations [ 6 ] . The present intervention changes the citation pointer and then the presentation of its selected column.
blocks.zh: 系统表式推理探测器使用证据扰动来检查模型行为[5]. 我们把这个逻辑应用于一个源支持验证器,同时持有操作和算术固定. TabDSR也使用表格数据扰动[6]. 本发言修改了引号,然后修改了其选定的一栏。

blocks.en: In each matched contrast, arm A retains the original citation and arm B points one operand to a different cell containing the same numerical value. Both arms use exact cell quotations and a neutral justification. The question, complete source, operand values, operation and executed result remain fixed. The changed pointer and its resolved context are the intended difference. Both arms therefore satisfy the same signed-number-at-pointer criterion.
blocks.zh: 在每一个相匹配的对比中,臂A保留了原始引号,臂B将一行指向一个包含相同数值的不同单元格。 两种武器都使用确切的引文和中立的理由。 问题、完整来源、操作值、操作和执行结果仍然固定不变。 已改变的指针及其已解决的上下文是预期的区别。 因此,两只武器都符合同样的签名编号标准。

blocks.en: Source review before inference separates clear wrong-role changes from equivalent facts and unresolved boundaries. Equivalent-fact labels require support from the source context as well as equal values. For example, an ending balance and the next period’s opening balance may represent the same carried-forward amount. Original proposed classes and subsequent pre-inference adjudications are both saved. Categories remain fixed throughout inference.
blocks.zh: 推论前的来源审查将明显的错误作用变化与等同的事实和未解决的界限区分开来. 等效-事实标签需要源上下文的支持以及等值. 例如,期末余额和下期期初余额可能代表同样的结转额。 原拟分类和随后的推论前裁定均被省去. 在整个推论中,类别保持不变。

blocks.en: Same value, wrong period (question 906). The question asks for Intel’s cumulative return relative to the Dow Jones U.S. Technology Index in 2010. The record divides Intel’s 157 by the index’s 191. Arm A cites /table/2/3 , headed "2010"; arm B cites /table/2/4 , headed "2011". Both index cells contain "$ 191", and the executed ratio remains 0.82. Numerical matching is preserved, while the swapped citation supplies the following year’s index fact. The citation contract requires the period requested by the question.
blocks.zh: 同值,误期(问题906)。 问题询问了英特尔相对于2010年道琼斯美国技术指数的累计回报. 记录将英特尔157除以指数191. Arm A引用/表/2/3,标题为"2010";arm B引用/表/2/4,标题为"2011". 两个索引单元格都包含"191美元",被执行的比例仍然为0.82. 数字匹配被保留下来,而互换引用提供了下一年的索引事实。 引用合同需要问题所要求的期限。

blocks.en: Different headings, equivalent fact (question 535). For December 2012 repurchases, arm A cites 102,400 total shares at /table/3/1 ; arm B cites the same count under publicly announced plans or programs at /table/3/3 . The preamble says the quarter’s repurchases were "pursuant to our publicly announced stock repurchase program", and note (1) attaches the total-purchase column to that program. This source statement, rather than equality alone, supports the equivalent-purchase-set label. Both arms retain the December average-price operand. The judgment concerns cited roles; fee completeness is a separate calculation question. Both examples include the assistant judgments and their source-based rationales for inspection.
blocks.zh: 不同的标题,等同的事实(问题535)。 在2012年12月的回购中,臂A在/表/3/1中引用了102,400份股份总额;臂B在/表/3/3中引用了公开宣布的计划或方案下的同样数目。 序言中说,该季度的回购是"根据我们公开宣布的股票回购计划",注(1)将总购入专栏附在了该方案上. 此源语句,而非单是平等,支持等同的购买-设置标签. 两只武器都保留了12月的平均价格。 判决涉及被引述的角色;费用完整性是一个单独的计算问题。 这两个例子包括助理判决及其基于来源的检查理由。

blocks.en: The prepared bank contains 42 evaluation calls over 12 questions; a source-only supplement adds 12 calls over three questions, with question 930 shared. Together they comprise 15 distinct contrasts over 14 questions: six clear wrong-role contrasts over five questions, six equivalent-fact controls and three boundary contrasts. Repeated identical payloads inherited from the natural traces contribute unequal numbers of technical calls. Fig. 1 averages technical calls within each arm, using the contrast as the semantic reporting unit. All 54 evaluation and eight format-check calls succeed.
blocks.zh: 已准备好的银行有42个评价电话,涉及12个问题;只有来源的补编增加了12个电话,涉及3个问题,共有930个问题。 它们共包括15个截然不同的14个问题:6个明显的错误作用与5个问题、6个等同事实控制和3个边界对比。 从天然痕迹中继承的重复的相同有效载荷造成了技术呼叫次数的不平等。 图1 平均每个臂内技术调用,以对比为语义报告单位. 所有54个评价和8个格式核对电话都成功。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Same-number citation contrasts under the original rendering. A retains the original citation; B cites a different same-number cell. Shading separates wrong roles, equivalent facts and boundaries. Two wrong-role and two equivalent-fact B means fall below the inclusive 0.8 cutoff. Question 930 contributes two contrasts. Means aggregate technical repeats within each arm; counts describe the constructed contrasts.
blocks.zh: 发相. 1:同号引文在原作渲染下作对比. A保留了原始引用;B引用了不同的同号单元格。 分出错的角色,等同的事实和界限. 两个错误作用和两个等效事实B意味着低于包容性0.8截取. 问题930提供了两种对比。 是指每个臂内的总技术重复;计数描述所构建的对比.

blocks.en: Two clear wrong-role B means fall below 0.8; four remain accepted, including wrong-period and wrong-status citations near 0.95. Two of six equivalent-fact B means also fall below 0.8. Boundary cases retain their unresolved status. High aggregate discrimination on natural records therefore coexists with missed role errors and sensitivity to equivalent citations in these constructed cases.
blocks.zh: 两个明显的错误作用B意味着跌至0.8以下;四个仍然被接受,包括错误时期和错误地位引用接近0.95. 6个等效实相B中的2个也低于0.8. 边界案件仍然处于未决状态。 因此,对自然记录的高度总体歧视与错失角色错误和对这些推定案件中同等引用的敏感性并存。

blocks.en: A post hoc structural split suggests a concrete follow-up. Seven contrasts change only the column; their B-minus-A shifts range from -0.045 to zero. Eight change the row, with or without the column; six B means fall below 0.8. Row changes also alter the surrounding numbers and text, so this split motivates a representation test. Column identity is already available through visible pointer indices and the complete table; the next experiment tests the effect of repeating it explicitly in the citation display.
blocks.zh: 一次临时的结构分裂建议采取具体的后续行动。 七相对比只改变柱;其B-减去A的相位从-0.045到0. 八更一行,有或无一列;六乙指跌至0.8以下. 行变化也改变周围的数字和文字,因此这种分化会激发一种表示测试. 列标识已经通过可见指针索引和完整表格提供;接下来的实验测试在引用显示中明确重复它的效果.

blocks.en: III-C Diagnosing selected failures through explicit column labels
blocks.zh: III-C 通过清晰的列标签分析选定的失败

blocks.en: We reuse all seven column-only contrasts, including four wrong-role contrasts on three questions, two equivalent-fact controls and the accounting/parser boundary. For each A/B arm, the enriched input adds only column_header=source.table[0][column_index] to every table citation lookup. The header is copied verbatim. Removing the added fields restores the original serialized state exactly. Source content, prompt, model instructions, annotations and numerical values remain fixed.
blocks.zh: 我们重新使用所有七个列的对比,包括在三个问题上的四个错作用对比,两个等同的实相控制和会计/parser边界. 对于每个A/B臂,被浓缩的输入器只在每张表格引用的检索中只添加了一栏_header=source.table [0][colln_index]. 页: 1 删除所添加的字段可以完全恢复原序列状态。 源内容,即时,模型指示,说明和数值保持不变.

blocks.en: The inputs and readout are saved before these new calls. Original and enriched renderings are recollected together in one randomized interleaved schedule (seed 80930), with two repetitions of each arm/rendering combination. This schedule supplies contemporaneous original controls for the enriched rendering. All 56 evaluation and four format calls succeed. The seven contrasts cover six source questions and 26 unique evaluation inputs. The two contrasts on question 930 share an A input, producing four technical A calls per rendering for that shared input.
blocks.zh: 在这些新呼叫之前,输入和读取被保存. 原生和被浓缩的渲染被用一个随机分取的相叶表(种子为80930)重新收录在一起,每个臂相/相接的组合重复两次. 这个调度为浓缩渲染提供了同时期的原始控制. 所有56项评价和4项格式调用都成功。 七个对比涉及六个来源问题和26个独特的评价投入。 问题930的两个对比是共享A输入,每次渲染生成4个技术A调用共享输入。

blocks.en: Fig. 2 shows every cell mean. The interaction is the enriched B-minus-A difference minus the original B-minus-A difference. A negative interaction indicates greater separation between the original and swapped citations; whether that separation is desirable depends on the semantic stratum.
blocks.zh: 图2显示每个细胞的阴性。 相互作用是被浓缩的B-减-A差异减去原来的B-减-A差异. 负面的相互作用表明原始引文和互换引文之间有较大的分出;这种分出是否可取取决于语义上层.

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Explicit-column intervention: all two-call A/B means and interactions. Interaction is explicit (B minus A) minus original (B minus A). Negative values indicate greater separation; wrong roles call for separation, whereas equivalent facts call for support in both arms. Boundary labels remain unresolved. Means are descriptive; question 930 shares a technically repeated A input.
blocks.zh: 发相. 2: 明确-分栏干预:所有双调A/B手段和互动. 相互作用是明确的(B减A)再减原生(B减A). 消极价值表明,分离程度更高;错误的作用要求分离,而同样的事实则要求两个武器都给予支持。 边界标签仍未解决。 手段是描述性的;问题930在技术上重复了A项投入。

blocks.en: For the four selected wrong-role contrasts, all eight B calls are accepted under the original rendering and withheld under the explicit rendering at 0.8. All corresponding A calls remain accepted in both conditions. Enriched A means range from 0.950 to 0.970, whereas enriched B means range from 0.115 to 0.620. The largest observed identical-input range is 0.05 in this repeat check. These matched observations support a representation effect on the tested period and status errors.
blocks.zh: 对于所选取的4个错误作用对比,所有8个B调在原渲染下被接受,并被明确渲染下被扣0.8. 所有对应的A电话在两种条件下都继续接受。 富集A指从0.950到0.970,而富集B指从0.115到0.620. 本次重复检查中观察到的最大相同输入范围为0.05个. 这些相匹配的意见支持了对试验期和状况错误的表示效果。

blocks.en: The equivalent controls reveal the cost to valid evidence. Both enriched B means are 0.785; one of their four individual calls is accepted at the inclusive cutoff. Question 583 also has an original A mean below 0.8, and enrichment lowers its A mean further, producing a positive interaction. Explicit labels thus change support for valid as well as wrong citations. The accounting/parser case retains its unresolved label. Coverage is limited to the seven column-only contrasts; the earlier row-changing opening/closing-balance controls were not rerun.
blocks.zh: 同等控制显示有效证据的成本。 两种浓缩的B手段都是0.785;在包容性的断接点上,它们四个单独通话中的一个被接受。 问题583的原A平均值也低于0.8,而浓缩进一步降低其A平均值,产生正相互作用. 因此,明确标签会改变对有效引用和错误引用的支持。 会计/审案保留了未解决的标签。 覆盖范围仅限于七个栏的对比;早先的行变化开/关闭-平衡控制没有重新运行.

blocks.en: On these selected cases, explicit column labels increase sensitivity to period and status mismatches while lowering support for some equivalent facts. This representation-sensitive tradeoff motivates the fresh-source test that follows.
blocks.zh: 在这些所选案件中,清晰的列标签提高了对时期和状态不匹配的敏感性,同时降低了对某些等同事实的支持. 这种注重代表性的取舍,推动了随后的新来源测试。

blocks.en: III-D Fresh source pages with a returned non-author review
blocks.zh: 附有返回的非作者审查的新鲜源页

blocks.en: To test beyond previously observed failures, we construct a separate bank from the pinned FinQA train split. After excluding 178 pages used by earlier local experiments, a structural screen yields 116 eligible questions on 91 pages: both operands must be leading signed numbers in table cells, with another same-value cell for at least one operand. A fixed hash ranking selects 36 questions on 36 pages from 35 reports, one question per page. A source-only rule chooses the original citations and the first alternative same-number cell in row-major order. The follow-up uses program-derived constructed records to test controlled citation changes. These pages are new to our local experiments; natural model-error frequencies and training-data overlap are outside this sampling design.
blocks.zh: 为了测试之前观察到的故障之外,我们从被封住的FinQA列车分出处建造了单独的银行. 在排除了早期本地实验使用的178页后,一个结构屏幕在91页中得出了116个合格的问题:两个操作符都必须在表格单元格中领先签名数字,至少一个操作符还有一个同值单元格. 一个固定的散列排名从35份报告的36页中选择了36个问题,每页一个问题. 一条仅源规则以行号顺序选择原始引用和第一个同号单元格。 后续使用程序衍生出已建记录来测试可控引号的更改. 这些页面对我们的当地实验来说是新的;自然模型-误差频率和培训-数据重叠是这种取样设计之外的.

blocks.en: Before inference we save the inputs, sample and original/explicit-column schedule. All 288 evaluation calls (two arms, two renderings, two repeats per question) and four format checks succeed. The prompt, model, column-field intervention and cutoffs are unchanged. One non-author reviewer returns labels for all 36 contrasts, declaring unaided reading of the supplied transcripts and no access to model outputs, author labels or the blinded X/Y mapping. Review took place after collection under the reviewer’s declared blindness. The reviewer assesses support for each complete citation set, including its unchanged operand. The labels reflect one reviewer per case; inter-human agreement remains unmeasured.

blocks.en: V Implications and relation to prior work
blocks.zh: 五 先前工作的影响和关系

blocks.en: V-A Incremental information and failure conditions
blocks.zh: 五-A 增量信息和故障条件

blocks.en: The natural-record comparison identifies the value of a strong numerical baseline: signed-number matching explains most recovery over exact quotation checks, while probabilistic verification offers different coverage and joint-pass tradeoffs across cutoffs. Same-number swaps then expose citation distinctions that numerical agreement alone cannot resolve. Jev responds to some wrong roles but misses others, and the acceptance policy also withholds some equivalent citations. The incremental-information question therefore requires both unsupported-role detection and supported-evidence retention.
blocks.zh: 自然记录比较确定了强数基线的价值:签名数字比对解释了大多数回收情况,而不是确切的报价核对,而概率核查则提供了不同的覆盖面和截断时的联通取舍。 同一数字的互换将暴露出仅凭数字协议无法解决的引用区别。 Jev回应了一些错误的角色,但忽略了另一些角色,而接受政策也保留了一些同等的引用. 因此,增量信息问题既需要不支持的作用检测,也需要支持的证据保留。

blocks.en: The row/column response difference motivates a controlled test of representation sensitivity. Making column identity explicit changes the tested period/status decisions, while equivalent controls distinguish justified rejection from withholding of valid evidence. The fresh-source follow-up retains this tradeoff under a non-author reviewer and reveals withholding of supported original citations at the chosen cutoff. Together, these comparisons identify sensitivity to the supplied representation and its acceptance-coverage consequences.
blocks.zh: 行/列反应差异激发了对表现灵敏度的控制测试. 使列身份明确改变试验期/状态的决定,而同等控制则区分合理拒绝和拒绝有效证据。 新的来源后续程序保留了这一取舍,由非作者审查者负责,并显示在选择的截止日期时拒绝提供支持的原始引用。 这些比较一起确定了对所提供表述及其接受范围后果的敏感性。

blocks.en: For financial research assistants, verification must check the link between an LLM-generated operand and documentary evidence. Tool execution checks the proposed arithmetic; citation verification additionally assesses the operand’s financial role. A verifier evaluation should test both rejection of unsupported roles and retention of equivalent evidence, such as carried-forward balances. Our matched inputs hold arithmetic fixed and evaluate emitted records, making cited-role support a distinct target alongside numerical correctness and answer release. Section IV retains the original fixed-gate release comparison as the workflow-level endpoint.
blocks.zh: 对于财务研究助理,核查必须检查LLM产生的操作与文件证据之间的联系。 工具执行检查提议的算术;引用核查还评估了操作员的财务作用。 核查员的评价应检验拒绝无凭据的角色和保留同等证据,例如结转余额。 我们的相匹配输入有固定的算术和评估所排放的记录,使被引用的作用支持在数字正确性和解答释放的同时成为一个明确的目标。 第四节保留了原固定门发布比较作为工作流程级终点.

blocks.en: V-B Closest precedents and scope of contribution
blocks.zh: 五-B 最接近的先例和贡献范围

blocks.en: JEV-as-a-Judge is a direct precedent for probabilistic judging and escalation [ 8 ] . Our experiments examine what a judge distinguishes in cited financial evidence. BudgetVerify studies the allocation of verification effort in financial QA [ 9 ] . Equal-number and equivalent-fact controls add a complementary evaluation axis: whether a verifier distinguishes unsupported roles from valid alternative citations.
blocks.zh: JEV-as-a法官是概率判断和升级的直接先例[8]. 我们的实验研究了法官在所引用的财务证据中的区别。 核查财政质量保证中核查工作的分配情况[9]。 等号和等效实控增加了一个互补的评价轴:一个核查者是否区分了无支持的角色和有效的替代引用.

blocks.en: Hume’s practitioner report probes Jev’s contextual behavior [ 10 ] . This provides a black-box precedent for examining sensitivity to the supplied context. Sun et al. study option-name binding in typed decision models [ 11 ] . Here the controlled variation concerns cited financial roles at fixed numerical values.
blocks.zh: Hume的从业者报告调查了Jev的背景行为[10]. 这为审查对所提供背景的敏感性提供了一个黑盒先例。 孙等. 研究在打入式决定模型中绑定的选项名称 [11]. 在此,受控的变异关切提到以固定数值计算的财务作用。

blocks.en: VeriFin combines financial evidence grounding with symbolic verification [ 12 ] . Our target is the probability assigned to support at a specified citation. FinCARDS aligns financial entities, metrics, periods and numerical spans for evidence reranking [ 13 ] . Checking the role of an already cited operand complements these grounding and reranking stages.
blocks.zh: VeriFin将财务证据与象征性核查相结合[12]. 我们的目标是在指定引用时指定支持的概率。 FinCARDS使金融实体、衡量尺度、期限和数字间距一致,以便重新排列证据[13]。 检查一个已经引用的操作程序的作用可以补充这些基础阶段和重新排序阶段。

blocks.en: FinRank likewise studies evidence-grounded financial question answering and retrieval over SEC filings [ 14 ] . The present study holds the available source fixed and varies a citation or its rendering. This controlled comparison connects numerical baselines, financial-role contrasts and equivalent-fact controls within the evaluation of a probabilistic verifier.
blocks.zh: FinRank同样研究了对证监会备案的循证财务问题的回答和检索[14]. 本研究报告将现有来源固定下来,并采用引用或渲染方式。 这种可控比较将数字基线、金融作用对比和对概率验证器的评价中的等同事实控制联系起来。

blocks.en: VI Limitations and reproducibility
blocks.zh: 六. 限制和可复制性

blocks.en: The natural bank is selected for single-operation calculations and spans overlapping company/year reports. The primary selector’s 95/96 key matches leave little room for the original gate to improve accuracy. Source PDFs, training contamination and historical information cutoffs are outside the evaluation’s scope. Historical labels come from unblinded assistant review. The fresh-source extension adds one returned non-author review, with blindness and method declared in its form; this is a single-reviewer assessment without inter-human reliability estimates or consensus adjudication. Temporal interpretation, malformed year headers, price-role completeness and source transcription defects require annotation judgment. One returned rationale explicitly infers missing year-column order from another supplied case, a context difference from the verifier’s per-question input; Section III-D reports its exclusion and a separate header-quality sensitivity. These analyses show dependence on label and source-quality choices; semantic label validity remains a separate requirement.
blocks.zh: 自然银行选作单业务计算,跨出重叠的公司/年报. 主选手的95/96密钥火柴给原门没有多少余地来提高准确性. 来源PDF、培训污染和历史信息断层不在评价范围之内。 历史标签来自无盲助手评论. 新鲜源扩展增加了一次返回的非作者审查,失明并用其形式宣布方法;这是一次单一的审查者评估,没有人类之间的可靠性估计或协商一致裁决. 时间解释、错误的年头、价格作用完整性和源的抄录缺陷都需要作出注释判断。 一个回覆的理由明确推断出另一个案例缺少了年栏顺序,这与核查者的每个问题输入有上下文差异;第三至D节报告将其排除在外,并有单独的标题质量敏感性。 这些分析显示依赖标签和源质选择;语义标签的有效性仍然是另外的要求.

blocks.en: The historical extensions are exploratory: the source verifier was specified after inspecting natural records, the relaxed deterministic baseline was added after inspecting verifier results, and the column intervention revisits observed failures in constructed citation swaps. Inputs and assistant labels were saved before each collection within this exploratory sequence. The 36-question follow-up avoids selection by verifier outcomes, while its structurally filtered, program-derived population limits generalization. Four negative rendering contrasts span only three source questions, and question 930 shares an A input. The two equivalent B means in the selected column-rendering study sit close to the cutoff, making these decisions sensitive to small probability changes. Counts describe the selected cases; failure prevalence in financial reports remains unmeasured.
blocks.zh: 历史扩展是探索性的:来源核实器在检查自然记录后被指定,在检查核实结果后被添加了宽松的确定性基线,而列干预重温所观察到的构建引用交换失败. 输入和辅助标签在此探索序列中每个收藏之前被保存. 36题后续可避免通过验证结果进行选择,而其结构被过滤出,由程序衍生出的人口限制了概括. 四个负渲染对比只跨出三个源问题,而问题930共享一个A输入. 两个等同的B表示在所选的列-递归研究中坐到切入点附近,使这些决定对小概率变化敏感. 计数说明选定的案例;财务报告中的失败率仍未计量。

blocks.en: The experiments evaluate one returned Jev identity and one generative alias. Technical repeats and two trace draws characterize observed serving variability; future serving behavior requires separate assessment. Source probabilities target cited-role support against the stated annotation source. Trading performance, live-agent improvement and the model’s internal reasoning are outside the evaluated endpoints.
blocks.zh: 实验评估了一个返回的Jev身份和一个基因别名. 技术重复和两个痕量图对观测到的服务可变性进行了定性;未来服务行为需要单独的评估. 来源概率目标与所述注解来源相对照。 交易性能,活体代理改进和模型的内部推理在评价的终点之外.

blocks.en: Saved records retain source revisions, selection decisions, prompts, serialized inputs, model/provider identities, exact probabilities, technical-repeat groups, costs and source-review reasons. Original endpoints and historical experiments retain their own records. Recorded costs, rounded to five decimal places, are USD 0.14781 for the 288-call natural-bank collection, USD 0.01669 for the 196-call source-verifier extension, USD 0.00488 for 62 swap-study calls including format checks, USD 0.00481 for the 60-call rendering experiment, and USD 0.02417 for the 292-call fresh-source follow-up. These charges document observed provider billing; the experiments use different tasks and call budgets. Offline numerical and input-invariant checks support numerical reproducibility; semantic assessment relies on the retained source review. A portable inspection packet retains exact instructions, source contexts, paired inputs, individual responses, label reasons and the complete natural-record disagreement table. The blinded packet and exact returned form preserve the follow-up review and declaration. A follow-up ledger retains all 288 probabilities, original-cutoff summaries and post hoc label/header sensitivities. The inspection artifacts are retained privately; public access remains pending.
blocks.zh: 保存的记录保留源修订、选择决定、提示、序列化输入、模型/提供者身份、确切概率、技术重复组、费用和源审查理由。 原始终点和历史实验保留了自己的记录. 记录成本,四舍五入到小数点后五位数,288调用天然银行收藏费为0.14781美元,196调用源核实器延期费为0.01669美元,62个交换学习电话费为0.0488美元,包括格式检查费为0.0481美元,60调用渲染实验费为0.0481美元,292调用新来源后续费为0.02417美元。 这些收费文件记录了供应商的账单;这些实验使用不同的任务和呼叫预算。 离线数字和输入-变量检查支持数字再生性;语义评估依赖于所保留的源审查. 便携式检查包保留了准确的说明、来源上下文、配对输入、个别答复、标签理由和完整的自然记录分歧表。 失明的包裹和准确退回的表格保留了后续审查和申报。 后续分类账保留了所有288个概率、原始截止日期摘要和特设标签/标题后敏感性。 检查文物由私人保留;公众仍可进入。

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en: For LLM-generated financial calculations, probabilistic evidence verification should be assessed by what it adds beyond numerical matching and by the citation changes under which it fails. On the retained natural records, a signed-number-at-pointer rule explains most recovery over exact quotation checks. Matched-number swaps reveal a separate requirement: distinguishing unsupported financial roles from alternative citations to equivalent facts. At the stated cutoff, Jev accepts some of the former and withholds some of the latter despite strong aggregate discrimination on natural records.
blocks.zh: 就LLM产生的财务计算而言,概率证据核实应当根据其超出数字比对的附加内容和它失败的引用变化进行评估。 在保留下来的自然记录上,一个签名的点名规则解释了大多数追偿比确切的出价检查要多. 相匹配的数字互换揭示了一个单独的要求:区分无支持的财务角色与替代引用等同的事实. 在规定的截止日期,Jev接受一些前者,并扣留了一些后者,尽管在自然记录方面存在着严重的集体歧视。

blocks.en: The fresh-source follow-up, with a separate reviewer, extends this evaluation to new pages and highlights the tradeoff between detecting unsupported roles and retaining valid citations. The contribution is a controlled evaluation combining numerical baselines, same-number swaps and equivalent-fact controls, with column rendering used to probe representation sensitivity. For LLM-based financial assistants, the evaluation separates numerical correctness, cited-role support and answer-release quality.
blocks.zh: 新来源的后续工作,加上一个单独的审查员,将本评价扩展到了新网页,并突出了发现不支持的角色和保留有效引用之间的取舍。 贡献是结合了数字基线、同数互换和等效实相控制的可控评价,并用柱渲染来探测表示敏感性。 对于基于LLM的财务助理,评价将数字正确性,引用作用支持和解答释放质量区分开来.
